title: 📹 The first authoritative reaction of Niloufar Shadmehri, Iran's cultural advisor in France, after returning to the country.
text:
📹 The first authoritative reaction of Niloufar Shadmehri, Iran's cultural advisor in France, after returning to the country."

"🔺Dr. Shadmehri was expelled from the country after 5 years of activity in a hostile and political move by the French government."

"📹 The story of the expulsion of the Iranian cultural counselor in France"

"🔺Niloufar Shadmehri: Due to the wrongdoing of two French diplomats who were expelled from Iran, the French government also retaliated by expelling two of Iran's cultural counselors in Paris; I had no action other than cultural and artistic activities.
